Class PhysicalUnitsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.PhysicalUnitsHelper
public final class PhysicalUnitsHelper extends Object
Pure static SI (International System of Units) dimensional conversion helper.

All unit conversions across Ether simulation engines, kernels, telemetry aggregators, and data loaders MUST pass through this single authoritative class. Inline magic conversion constants (such as 31.688, 3.15576e7, 273.15, 1e-3, or 365.25) are strictly prohibited inside physics formulas so that dimensional consistency can be audited and verified in one central location.

Canonical SI Base & Derived Conventions

  • Time: seconds ($\text{s}$), Julian days ($86\,400\,\text{s}$), Julian years ($365.25\,\text{d} = 31\,557\,600\,\text{s}$).
  • Energy & Power: Joules ($\text{J}$), Gigajoules ($\text{GJ} = 10^9\,\text{J}$), Watts ($\text{W} = \text{J}\cdot\text{s}^{-1}$).
  • Mass: kilograms ($\text{kg}$), metric tonnes ($\text{t} = 1\,000\,\text{kg}$).
  • Temperature: Kelvin ($\text{K}$), degrees Celsius ($T_{\text{K}} = T_{^\circ\text{C}} + 273.15$).
  • Length & Area: meters ($\text{m}$), kilometers ($\text{km} = 10^3\,\text{m}$), square kilometers ($\text{km}^2 = 10^6\,\text{m}^2$).
